readme: Organization, Agents, Skills, Rules, Tools and Filetype each use the latest Marketing master's column headings exactly. Marketing and Manufacturing records sit together in one table per master, with no extra columns.
Organization > Agents > Skills > Rules > Tools > Filetype
Reference direction only. Each master can map to one or multiple earlier masters.

Manufacturing fields were placed in the closest Marketing column. Original Manufacturing fields are kept as JSON in the preserved-snapshot or evidence column where the master has one. Manufacturing IDs are prefixed MFG- (Organization uses the source code; Tools keeps TOOL-MFG-NN).

Marketing: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nX3qDQAygIUI1j5xEv8-znJBplOUmjEXZTga_URcwwM/edit  Manufacturing: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zj1FHA9Tp6jw-pCFfBtOsSDW4xSRwRUb5lr8ZgUz90E/edit . Copied 26 Oct 2026; later source edits do not flow here. Manufacturing source is read only.
Superseded - Organization/Agents/Skills/Rules/Tools hold the previous common layout (with the Domain, key and provenance columns), hidden and not deleted.
No collaborators or anyone-with-link permissions added.

sheets.name: Organization
descriptions: Company / business unit name and type (HQ, branch, department or resource)
Company/business unit certifications. Certificate on the first line; Validity (dd-mm-yyyy) on the second line.
Company segment/niche, context and goal priorities; approved services / offers
ICP / customer segments as four stacked lines: Customers, Suppliers, Audience, Other. One label per line, content after it.
Governed document / source versions. One linked document per line, each opening its own file or sheet.

Software only. Feeder: BuLLM Tech Stack & Tool Factory > Repo Library. Store canonical repo / Tooling ID, version and tenant account refs; no credentials. See README feeder note. Reference mapping, not live sync.
Physical hardware only: asset ID, device/equipment type, assigned unit/owner and inventory/evidence ref. Legacy unclassified values retained pending review; not hardware verification.

sheets.name: Agents
descriptions: Existing agent / External agent / Proposed agent
Tenant-scoped source pointer and allowed tools

sheets.name: Skills
descriptions: Source. Governed S3/Postgres/DuckDB ref, not file copy
Finalized agent IDs using this skill

sheets.name: Rules
descriptions: Stable rule key; one rule per row.
Name, type and short definition. Types: Policy, Prompt, Estimation, Calculation, Validation, Decision/routing.
Source/version + approval + evidence reference. Original records and historical snapshots...
Org IDs + Skill IDs are joins to the live tabs. Mapping marked proposed is not approved applicability. State inputs, runtime point and required check together.
What happens on failure, missing data or conflict.
Accountable owner + rule version; TBD until confirmed.
Proposed is not approved or implemented. Test cases are not executed tests.
Start / expiry / review date; TBD is not active.

values: Material Pricing · Calculation; Looks up the material price for a quote line, from a governed price source.
Surface Finish · Calculation; Adds surface finish cost from finish type and area.
Currency Converter · Calculation; Converts quote currencies into one base currency with dated rates.
Machine Hour Rate · Calculation; Works out the hourly machine rate from machine cost, utilisation and overheads.
Costing Rules · Estimation; Rolls material, finish and machine time up into one estimate.

sheets.name: Tools
descriptions: Confirmed URL / repo / document path; otherwise TBD
Registry version/date; tool version or freshness TBD
Agent, Assistant, MCP server, OSS repo, Skill, API, Framework or Enterprise system
Leaderboard, Repo Library, Skill Library or Tech Stack
BuLLM Recommended, BuLLM Tested, Gap or High fit
